newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian forex market inactive as banks staff strike.
newsitem.headline: Indian forex market inactive as banks staff strike.

text.p: India's inter-bank foreign exchange market was inactive on Friday as bank staff across the country struck work, dealers said.
"We did not transact any local business today," said a dealer at a leading foreign bank in Bombay.
"We did a few deals with our overseas counterparts."
The State Bank of India, the leading bank and the major force in the foreign exchange market, was absent from the scene on Friday because of the strike.
The forward dollar market was also dead, dealers said.
Trade unions representing bank employees are protesting against government's plan to permit private banks to set up branches in rural areas.
The rupee closed at 35.86/77 against the dollar on Thursday. The market reopens on Monday.
